scope: Manual review of the 10 collected answers, tool evidence and remotely retrieved traces; observations, not a comprehensive evaluation score.
runtime: Current PydanticAI implementation with native model/tool instrumentation

patterns.observation: Simple data requests used 2 model calls and 1 tool call.
The incomplete query asked for a section using 1 model call and no tools.
The dataset_id output validator triggered a retry; each session required 3 model calls although Q03/Q09 each called only one data tool.
An empty Pareto triggered a summary lookup to distinguish an existing healthy control from absent controls; 3 model calls and 2 tools.
Lowercase te was normalized to TE; last month resolved to 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31 using the November 6 reference date.
The zero-total Pareto retained the observed zero-quantity defect code and labelled null shares as undefined.

issues.observation: The overall removal total was correctly stated as 12, but the displayed control breakdown gave 3 and 8 (sum 11).
issues.expected: List the original record quantities 3, 1 and 8 without treating the first defect row as the whole control.

issues.observation: The comparison displayed control_count=0 for August but omitted the required unknown-coverage warning and described increased defect activity versus that month.
issues.expected: Explicitly state that August has no matching controls and unknown coverage; do not infer a real operational change from missing data.

limitations: These are automated interactions through Streamlit AppTest and real model requests, not manual browser sessions or production-user traffic.
All reporting data is synthetic. Each query starts a fresh conversation; this collection does not measure multi-turn context growth.
Costs use the project rate table at standard input rates, without cache discounts; estimates are not invoice charges.
Logfire ingestion was verified through the query API; the dashboard UI was not inspected.
